name: Clypmint API
description: Everything the Clypmint MCP tools do, over HTTP: make videos from footage, links or words; change them in words, by scene or caption; plan, make and schedule a month of posts. Start an edit to get a private upload link for the video, then check the video until it is ready. Spending calls say their credit cost and take dry_run: true to price a request first.
